guides.title: Welcome to Premium SaaS
guides.summary: Welcome to Premium SaaS, the Moodle theme from LMS Labs.
steps: Welcome to Premium SaaS, the Moodle theme from LMS Labs.
In this tutorial we will walk through every screen, one click at a time, exactly as you would use it every day.
If you have ever clicked through five pages to reach one setting, this is for you.

guides.title: The menu and the top bar
guides.summary: Everything starts with the menu down the left.
steps: Everything starts with the menu down the left.
It is grouped by the jobs you do: users, courses, training, reports, admin tools and site.
Across the top is search, the colour changer, field tips and your notifications.

guides.title: Dashboard numbers
guides.summary: Your dashboard opens with a greeting and the numbers that matter: unread messages, how many submissions are waiting to be marked, who is active today, and new people this week.
steps: Your dashboard opens with a greeting and the numbers that matter: unread messages, how many submissions are waiting to be marked, who is active today, and new people this week.

guides.title: Resume and due this week
guides.summary: Underneath, the resume card takes you straight back to where you left off, and the due this week panel shows what is coming up.
steps: Underneath, the resume card takes you straight back to where you left off, and the due this week panel shows what is coming up.
Quick links to your LMS Labs tools sit below.

guides.title: Search with Ctrl K
guides.summary: Search is built into the top bar.
steps: Search is built into the top bar.
Press control K from any page, and a search box opens.
Type a page, a course or a setting and press enter.
Site administrators can search every Moodle setting from the same box.

guides.title: Change the colour
guides.summary: The coloured dot at the top right changes the colour of the whole site.
steps: The coloured dot at the top right changes the colour of the whole site.
Pick a colour and every page changes straight away.
Site owners set the default for everyone in Theme settings.

guides.title: Field tips
guides.summary: Next to it is the field tips button.
steps: Next to it is the field tips button.
Turn it on and a small question mark appears beside each setting, with a plain English explanation.
Turn it off again and the page goes back to clean.

guides.title: Notifications bell
guides.summary: The bell shows your notifications.
steps: The bell shows your notifications.
You can mark them all as read, open the full list, or open your notification preferences from here.

guides.title: All users
guides.summary: The all users page lists everyone on the site.
steps: The all users page lists everyone on the site.
Search by name, filter by role, course, cohort or status, and sort the list.
Tick people to act on several at once.

guides.title: Add a new user
guides.summary: Add a new user is a single page.
steps: Add a new user is a single page.
Enter the name, email and username, choose a password or let the person set their own, and your last choices are remembered.

guides.title: Upload users
guides.summary: Upload users is built for the job.
steps: Upload users is built for the job.
Drop a CSV file on the box and it is checked before anything is created.
Below it, a plain list shows exactly which columns the file needs.

guides.title: Upload preview
guides.summary: After you drop a file, a preview lets you check that the columns line up with the data.
steps: After you drop a file, a preview lets you check that the columns line up with the data.
Choose whether to add new people, update existing people, or both, then import.

guides.title: Bulk user actions
guides.summary: Bulk user actions starts with the same filters as the all users page.
steps: Bulk user actions starts with the same filters as the all users page.
Tick the people you want, or take everyone who matches, then choose what to do: enrol them, add them to a cohort, send a message, suspend them or ask for a new password.

guides.title: Cohorts
guides.summary: Cohorts group people across the whole site, for example everyone at a campus or in an intake.
steps: Cohorts group people across the whole site, for example everyone at a campus or in an intake.
Create a cohort, paste in a list of emails or usernames to add people, and use it to enrol groups or to give a client their own branding.

guides.title: Email students
guides.summary: Email students sends a well formatted email to exactly the right people, using your site's mail settings.
steps: Email students sends a well formatted email to exactly the right people, using your site's mail settings.
Choose who to send to, by course, category, group or role, check the recipient count, then send.
You can send yourself a test, or save the message as a template.

guides.title: Courses and categories
guides.summary: Courses and categories turns Moodle's course management page into big, clear cards.
steps: Courses and categories turns Moodle's course management page into big, clear cards.
At the top you see how many courses you have, how many are visible to learners, and how many are hidden.

guides.title: Search, filter and show or hide
guides.summary: Search the list, filter by visible, hidden, or courses with no learners yet, and show or hide a course with a single click on its badge.
steps: Search the list, filter by visible, hidden, or courses with no learners yet, and show or hide a course with a single click on its badge.
Drag a card to change its place.

guides.title: Add a course
guides.summary: Add a course keeps everything on one page.
steps: Add a course keeps everything on one page.
Enter the full name and short name, choose a category and dates, and switch on the options you use most.
Your last choices are remembered.

guides.title: Upload courses
guides.summary: Upload courses creates many courses at once from a CSV file.
steps: Upload courses creates many courses at once from a CSV file.
Choose whether to create new courses, update existing ones, or both, and turn off visible if you want to review them first.

guides.title: Programs
guides.summary: Programs group courses for your learners.
steps: Programs group courses for your learners.
Each program shows a set of courses on the My courses page, in the order you choose, with unlock rules.
Learners can be placed in several programs at the same time.

guides.title: Program details and audience
guides.summary: In the program editor you name the program, then choose who sees it: everyone, or only learners who match cohorts, course categories, course groups or profile fields.
steps: In the program editor you name the program, then choose who sees it: everyone, or only learners who match cohorts, course categories, course groups or profile fields.

guides.title: Program courses and rules
guides.summary: Add the courses, drag them into the order learners should follow, and add headings to split them into sections.
steps: Add the courses, drag them into the order learners should follow, and add headings to split them into sections.
Under each course you can set when it opens, for example straight away, or when the previous course is complete, and a delay in days or hours.
Save when you are done.

guides.title: Restore a course
guides.summary: Restore a course takes a backup file and creates a new course from it.
steps: Restore a course takes a backup file and creates a new course from it.
Drop the file, choose the category, and review what will be included before you restore.

guides.title: Course home
guides.summary: Opening a course shows the course home, and the left menu changes to the tools for that course.
steps: Opening a course shows the course home, and the left menu changes to the tools for that course.
Everything a trainer needs is listed here, in the order you tend to use it.

guides.title: Student view
guides.summary: At the top is the student view button.
steps: At the top is the student view button.
One click shows the course exactly as a learner sees it, without logging out, and one click on return to my view brings you back.

guides.title: Participants
guides.summary: Participants lists everyone enrolled in the course, with their roles, groups and last access.
steps: Participants lists everyone enrolled in the course, with their roles, groups and last access.
Filter the list, enrol new people, and open any person to see their details.

guides.title: Grading
guides.summary: Grading is your marking queue.
steps: Grading is your marking queue.
It lists the submissions waiting for you across the course, so you can open the next one straight away.
Written assignments open in Fast Grade, and quiz essay questions open in the AI essay grader when it is installed.

guides.title: Gradebook
guides.summary: The gradebook is the heart of the theme.
steps: The gradebook is the heart of the theme.
A chooser at the top changes how marks show: satisfactory and not yet satisfactory, marks, percentage, grade, or your own custom points.
Filled green and amber cells make results easy to read at a glance.

guides.title: Needs marking and cohort row
guides.summary: A needs marking cell opens the marking screen directly.
steps: A needs marking cell opens the marking screen directly.

The learner column stays in view as you scroll, a cohort row at the bottom summarises each column, and stat chips at the top count who needs marking, who is not yet satisfactory, who has not submitted, and who is competent.

guides.title: Overrides
guides.summary: Overrides lets you give one person, or a group, different dates or limits on an assignment or quiz.
steps: Overrides lets you give one person, or a group, different dates or limits on an assignment or quiz.
Choose the activity, choose the people, set the new dates, and save.

guides.title: Course reports
guides.summary: Reports gives you a live picture of the course: what is happening right now, activity for every day, and a list of learners who need attention, such as people who have not started or have not been back for two weeks.
steps: Reports gives you a live picture of the course: what is happening right now, activity for every day, and a list of learners who need attention, such as people who have not started or have not been back for two weeks.

guides.title: Course completion
guides.summary: Course completion explains, in plain language, when a learner is complete.
steps: Course completion explains, in plain language, when a learner is complete.
Choose whether every activity must be done, only selected activities, a date, or a teacher sign off, and see how many learners have completed so far.

guides.title: Groups
guides.summary: Groups splits learners into smaller sets for activities, marking and messages.
steps: Groups splits learners into smaller sets for activities, marking and messages.
Create a group by hand, or use auto create to make several at once, and add people with a simple picker.

guides.title: Enrolment methods
guides.summary: Enrolment methods shows how people get into the course.
steps: Enrolment methods shows how people get into the course.
Turn a method on or off, change its settings, or add another method, such as manual enrolment or self enrolment.

guides.title: Question bank
guides.summary: The question bank holds the questions you write for quizzes.
steps: The question bank holds the questions you write for quizzes.
Pick a question type to write your first one, and organise questions into banks and categories.

guides.title: Course badges
guides.summary: Badges lets you create and award badges for this course, so learners can share what they have achieved.
steps: Badges lets you create and award badges for this course, so learners can share what they have achieved.

guides.title: Course settings
guides.summary: Course settings keeps the details you change most on one page: the name, the dates, the summary and the course image.
steps: Course settings keeps the details you change most on one page: the name, the dates, the summary and the course image.
If the AI course format is installed, its options sit in their own card on the same page.

guides.title: Backup
guides.summary: Backup makes a file of the course that you can download, keep, or restore into another course.
steps: Backup makes a file of the course that you can download, keep, or restore into another course.
Choose a course only backup to reuse the course, or include learner data to archive it.
Your existing backups are listed below, newest first.

guides.title: Restore inside a course
guides.summary: Restore, inside a course, brings a backup into this course.
steps: Restore, inside a course, brings a backup into this course.
Choose the file, then choose whether to merge it with what is here or replace it.

guides.title: Import
guides.summary: Import copies the activities and resources from another course into this one.
steps: Import copies the activities and resources from another course into this one.
Pick the course, and no learner data comes across.

guides.title: Reset
guides.summary: Reset gets the course ready for a new intake.
steps: Reset gets the course ready for a new intake.
The usual choices are already switched on: it removes learner work, unenrols learners, and can move the dates forward, while keeping the teachers and the course content.

guides.title: Group management
guides.summary: Group management is an LMS Labs plugin for intakes.
steps: Group management is an LMS Labs plugin for intakes.
Pick a course to manage its intake groups and time controlled access.
Trainers only see the courses they teach.

guides.title: Intake groups in a course
guides.summary: For each course you create intake groups, set when each group can open the course, and see who is in it.
steps: For each course you create intake groups, set when each group can open the course, and see who is in it.
Learners outside their group's dates see a clear message instead of an error.

guides.title: Course availability
guides.summary: Course availability delays when a course opens for each learner.
steps: Course availability delays when a course opens for each learner.
Set a number of days after enrolment, or a fixed date, one course at a time or by uploading a CSV file.
The current rules are listed below, ready to change.

guides.title: Recertification
guides.summary: Recertification resets a course when a learner's certificate is due again.
steps: Recertification resets a course when a learner's certificate is due again.
Choose a schedule, such as every twelve months, or relative to the enrolment date, and how much to reset.
Warnings go out before the reset, and every action is recorded in the audit log below.

guides.title: Add a recertification schedule
guides.summary: Adding a schedule takes one page.
steps: Adding a schedule takes one page.
Choose the course, the interval, who is warned and when, and whether to keep completion, grades or activity data.

guides.title: Auto-suspend
guides.summary: Auto suspend pauses a learner's access when they finish a course, so certificates and records stay tidy.
steps: Auto suspend pauses a learner's access when they finish a course, so certificates and records stay tidy.
Turn it on for a whole category or for single courses, and see the activity in its own tab.

guides.title: Course prerequisites
guides.summary: Course prerequisites lock a course until another is finished.
steps: Course prerequisites lock a course until another is finished.
Choose the prerequisite, choose the target courses, and add the gate.
Learners see exactly what to complete first.

guides.title: Training matrix dashboard
guides.summary: The Training matrix tracks who has completed which training, and when it expires.
steps: The Training matrix tracks who has completed which training, and when it expires.
The dashboard shows total staff, fully compliant, expiring soon and overdue, with the next expiries listed underneath.

guides.title: Training matrix staff
guides.summary: The staff tab lists each person with their position, department and compliance, so you can see at a glance who needs attention.
steps: The staff tab lists each person with their position, department and compliance, so you can see at a glance who needs attention.

guides.title: Training matrix reports
guides.summary: Reports gives you ready made views by department, plus a spreadsheet export for audit time.
steps: Reports gives you ready made views by department, plus a spreadsheet export for audit time.

guides.title: What trainers see
guides.summary: A trainer sees the same screens, but only for the learners enrolled in their own courses.
steps: A trainer sees the same screens, but only for the learners enrolled in their own courses.
Administrators and the site owner see everyone.
Nobody is shown people they should not see.

guides.title: Training pathways
guides.summary: Training pathways build step by step programs for your team, with stages and tasks.
steps: Training pathways build step by step programs for your team, with stages and tasks.
Each card shows its stages, tasks and active assignments.
A pathway that already has learner history is locked, so you duplicate it to change it.

guides.title: Assign a pathway
guides.summary: Assigning a pathway takes a minute.
steps: Assigning a pathway takes a minute.
Choose the pathway, tick the people, set a target date and assign.
Trainers can assign to their own learners.

guides.title: Team dashboard
guides.summary: The team dashboard shows every active assignment, with progress and overdue dates, and lets you sign off tasks that need a manager.
steps: The team dashboard shows every active assignment, with progress and overdue dates, and lets you sign off tasks that need a manager.

guides.title: Evidence export
guides.summary: Evidence export collects assessment evidence for audit.
steps: Evidence export collects assessment evidence for audit.
Pick a student, choose an enrolled course, choose the assessments, and download a PDF with a ZIP of the files.

guides.title: My training
guides.summary: Learners get a clear My training page, with their courses, certificates and expiry dates in one place.
steps: Learners get a clear My training page, with their courses, certificates and expiry dates in one place.
Due dates and expiry dates are shown separately, so nothing is mixed up.

guides.title: My pathway
guides.summary: And My pathway shows each learner their stages, their progress and the next task, with a button to mark it complete.
steps: And My pathway shows each learner their stages, their progress and the next task, with a button to mark it complete.

guides.title: Beacon Reports overview
guides.summary: Beacon Reports is the LMS Labs reporting plugin, and it sits in the left menu.
steps: Beacon Reports is the LMS Labs reporting plugin, and it sits in the left menu.
The overview gives you stat cards, KPI gauges, ready made reports and charts, live from your Moodle data, with no query building.

guides.title: Stat cards
guides.summary: Stat cards show single numbers, such as enrolments, completions and active learners.
steps: Stat cards show single numbers, such as enrolments, completions and active learners.
Search the list, filter by group, and choose what shows on your overview.

guides.title: KPI gauges
guides.summary: KPI gauges show how you are tracking against a target, so you can see at a glance whether completion, engagement and compliance are where they should be.
steps: KPI gauges show how you are tracking against a target, so you can see at a glance whether completion, engagement and compliance are where they should be.

guides.title: Reports
guides.summary: The reports tab lists ready made reports for people, progress, assessment, engagement, compliance and operations.
steps: The reports tab lists ready made reports for people, progress, assessment, engagement, compliance and operations.
Open one to see the full table, or request a new report.

guides.title: Charts
guides.summary: The charts tab turns the same data into charts you can read in seconds.
steps: The charts tab turns the same data into charts you can read in seconds.

guides.title: Speed Up
guides.summary: Speed Up checks how fast your site is and tells you what to fix.
steps: Speed Up checks how fast your site is and tells you what to fix.

It checks that recording is on, runs a one minute quick check of your database, storage, cache and web server, collects real usage, and then ranks the fixes by how much waiting time they save your users.

guides.title: 2FA and SSO
guides.summary: Simple 2FA and SSO sets up secure sign in.
steps: Simple 2FA and SSO sets up secure sign in.
Turn on two factor authentication for site administrators with no other settings, then choose who else needs it.
Single sign on lets people sign in with an outside provider, using the details you enter here.

guides.title: Media optimiser
guides.summary: Media optimiser finds the files that are costing you storage.
steps: Media optimiser finds the files that are costing you storage.
It shows how much space you use, what you could save, and which files to fix first, so a few large videos do not slow your site or fill your hosting plan.

guides.title: Media file browser
guides.summary: The file browser lists every file, by size and by impact, with the courses that use it, so you know what is safe to change.
steps: The file browser lists every file, by size and by impact, with the courses that use it, so you know what is safe to change.

guides.title: Cohort branding
guides.summary: Cohort branding gives each client their own logo, colours and font.
steps: Cohort branding gives each client their own logo, colours and font.
Add a branding, choose the cohort, and people in that cohort see their own look as soon as they sign in.
Everyone still shares one site.

guides.title: Edit a branding
guides.summary: Each branding sets the colour, the font and the logo, with a live preview, so you see the result before you save.
steps: Each branding sets the colour, the font and the logo, with a live preview, so you see the result before you save.

guides.title: Purge caches
guides.summary: Purge caches clears the site caches in one click, with no hunting through settings.
steps: Purge caches clears the site caches in one click, with no hunting through settings.
You return to the page you were on.

guides.title: Get started
guides.summary: Get started is a checklist for new site owners.
steps: Get started is a checklist for new site owners.
It walks through adding your logo and colour, naming your site, adding a support contact, connecting email, adding people, creating a first course and creating a program.
When every step is green, you can hide the card from the menu.

guides.title: Theme settings
guides.summary: Theme settings is where you set the look of the whole site: your name, colour and logo, the login page photo, the font, the contact details shown in the top bar, and the outgoing email settings.
steps: Theme settings is where you set the look of the whole site: your name, colour and logo, the login page photo, the font, the contact details shown in the top bar, and the outgoing email settings.

guides.title: Hosting provider
guides.summary: The hosting provider page shows who hosts the site and how to reach them for support.
steps: The hosting provider page shows who hosts the site and how to reach them for support.
Site administrators can also switch off the LMS Labs bar here at a client's request.

guides.title: Advanced settings and Boost view
guides.summary: When you need a deep technical setting, choose advanced settings.
steps: When you need a deep technical setting, choose advanced settings.
It switches to the standard Boost view with every Moodle setting, in one click.

guides.title: Back to Premium SaaS
guides.summary: A button at the bottom of the menu brings you straight back to Premium SaaS.
steps: A button at the bottom of the menu brings you straight back to Premium SaaS.
Developers get everything, and everyone else gets a simpler site.

guides.title: Your menu
guides.summary: Your own pages are in the menu under your name: my courses, calendar, grades, badges, messages, notifications, profile, preferences and log out.
steps: Your own pages are in the menu under your name: my courses, calendar, grades, badges, messages, notifications, profile, preferences and log out.

guides.title: My courses
guides.summary: My courses shows each learner their programs, with progress and a big resume button, instead of a wall of course tiles.
steps: My courses shows each learner their programs, with progress and a big resume button, instead of a wall of course tiles.

guides.title: Calendar
guides.summary: The calendar has agenda, week and month views.
steps: The calendar has agenda, week and month views.
Events from every course show in one place, with a list of what is coming up, and a button to add your own event.

guides.title: My grades
guides.summary: My grades shows each learner their average, the latest marks and every course, with a link to see every grade.
steps: My grades shows each learner their average, the latest marks and every course, with a link to see every grade.

guides.title: My badges
guides.summary: My badges lists the badges you have earned.
steps: My badges lists the badges you have earned.
Share them on LinkedIn, download them, or keep them in a backpack.
Each one links to a page that proves it is genuine.

guides.title: Messages
guides.summary: Messages is a full page inbox.
steps: Messages is a full page inbox.
Search conversations, filter by unread, starred or groups, and write a new message from the same screen.

guides.title: Notifications
guides.summary: Notifications lists everything sent to you, grouped by day and by type, with a button to mark them all as read.
steps: Notifications lists everything sent to you, grouped by day and by type, with a button to mark them all as read.

guides.title: Profile
guides.summary: Your profile shows your details and your courses, and you can edit them from here.
steps: Your profile shows your details and your courses, and you can edit them from here.

guides.title: Preferences
guides.summary: Preferences keeps the settings most people change on one page, and saves them the moment you change them: your language, time zone, email notifications, forum options and editor.
steps: Preferences keeps the settings most people change on one page, and saves them the moment you change them: your language, time zone, email notifications, forum options and editor.

guides.title: The help centre
guides.summary: The help centre is built in.
steps: The help centre is built in.
Search the guides, filter by who you are and what you want to do, and open any guide.
The guides follow this video, chapter by chapter.

guides.title: Numbered guides
guides.summary: Each guide shows numbered steps beside a real screenshot.
steps: Each guide shows numbered steps beside a real screenshot.
Every number is joined by a thin line to an outline box around the exact part of the screen, so you can see where to click.

guides.title: Wrap up
guides.summary: That is every screen in Premium SaaS.
steps: That is every screen in Premium SaaS.
A calm premium look, one click colour, control K to jump anywhere, tools for every job in the left menu, and visual help built in.
Premium SaaS is a theme from LMS Labs, by LMS Hosting Services.
Find more at L M S labs dot com, and thanks for watching.
